title: 1955 AHSME Problem 2
statement: The smaller angle between the hands of a clock at \(12{:}25\) p.m. is:

solutions.text:
At \(12{:}25,\) the minute hand is \(25\cdot6^\circ=150^\circ\) past \(12,\) while the hour hand is \(25\cdot0.5^\circ=12.5^\circ.\) Their smaller separation is \[ 150^\circ-12.5^\circ=137.5^\circ=137^\circ30'. \]

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: In \(25\) minutes, the minute hand moves \(150^\circ\)
The hour hand moves \(0.5^\circ\) per minute
